title: How Much It Can Carry: The Arm's Torque, the Base's Braking and Traction, and Which One Says No First

artifact.note: the heaviest payload a mobile manipulator may carry, as the least of three limits: what the arm's joints can hold at the pose (29-08), what the base can carry and still be able to stop in a given distance without tipping (33-05), and what its wheels can accelerate with a wanted acceleration (the drive's force, the friction of the floor); and what a payload does to the base's range on a battery (rolling resistance grows with the mass), and which limit is the binding one
